name: reelsinary
description: Build and publish travel guides of your own places from your reels, links and notes by talking to ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Reelsinary is for travel creators who turn their recommendations into guides for their followers: a map of the creator's own places, each with a tip in their own words and their own photos.

Build a guide by talking to ChatGPT, without opening an editor:
- Start a guide for a destination and add places by name. Each place is matched to Google Maps.
- Add the places from your Instagram reels and posts, Google Maps links and blog articles.
- Write a tip for each place from what you tell ChatGPT, in your own voice.
- Add your own photos with an in-chat drop box, and choose the cover.
- Set up the listing: which places everyone sees first, a one-line pitch and the keyword your followers send.
- Preview exactly what will go live, and publish when you say so.
- See how your guides are doing: views and sales.

Nothing goes live until you confirm the preview, and ChatGPT never picks places for you: a guide holds only the places you name or link.

You need a Reelsinary creator account. Linking Instagram and setting up payouts happen on reelsinary.com, not in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Start a guide for my favourite places in Lisbon
Add the places from this reel to my guide

positive.description: Sales and views for the creator's own guides
positive.prompt: How are my Reelsinary guides doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's guides with views, sales and earnings for each (the live guide Lisbon in 48 hours has views and no sales), and links to Creator HQ for details.

positive.description: Start a guide and add places by name
positive.prompt: Start a new Reelsinary guide called Rome weekend and add the Pantheon and the Trevi Fountain.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft guide named Rome weekend and adds the Pantheon and the Trevi Fountain, each matched to Google Maps. The reply confirms both places and gives the guide's editor link.

positive.description: Start a guide from an article's places
positive.prompt: Start a Reelsinary guide called Porto from an article and add the places in it: https://www.abroadwithash.com/best-coffee-shops-cafes-in-porto-portugal/
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new draft guide named Porto from an article with the places the article recommends, matched to Google Maps, and says how many were added.

positive.description: Set up the listing and preview it without publishing
positive.prompt: Make my Porto coffee guide free, show Majestic Café to everyone, use the pitch Five cafés worth the queue, and show me what publishing would look like.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the Porto coffee listing as a free draft with Majestic Café as the free place and the pitch, then shows the preview: title, free, number of places, pitch and the sale page address. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Add the creator's own photo with the in-chat drop box
positive.prompt: I want to add my own photo to Majestic Café in my Porto coffee guide.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the photo drop box for Majestic Café. Choosing a JPEG or PNG adds it to the place and offers Make it the cover. Where the box can't be shown, the reply gives a link to upload the photo in the Reelsinary editor.

negative.description: Planning a trip for the user is not something the plugin does
negative.prompt: Plan me a three-day trip to Lisbon with the best places to see.
negative.expected_behavior: No guide is created or changed. Reelsinary only builds guides of a creator's own places, so ChatGPT plans the trip itself and at most reads the creator's existing guides.

negative.description: There is no tool that deletes guides
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted, paused or changed. ChatGPT says guides can't be deleted from the chat; at most it lists them with list_guides.

negative.description: Another creator's data is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the sales of another Reelsinary creator, @someoneelse.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says it can only show the signed-in creator's own guides and sales, and shows no other creator's data.

review.commerce_description: Reelsinary sells nothing to the ChatGPT user. The plugin is a tool for sellers: a travel creator builds their own guide and can set its price. Their followers buy it on reelsinary.com, outside ChatGPT. No purchase, payment or checkout happens in ChatGPT, and no tool offers a plan, credits or an upgrade.

publication.release_notes: First release: build, illustrate and publish Reelsinary travel guides from ChatGPT.
